name: Repuestos Avenida
description: Uruguayan online store selling spare parts and accessories for cars and trucks, with a cart page. Delivery terms are described only briefly on the homepage and in its FAQ.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de repuestos y accesorios para autos y camiones, con página de carrito. Las condiciones de entrega se describen brevemente en la página de inicio y en sus preguntas frecuentes.

ships_to.notes: Homepage mentions a general 5 to 7 business day delay and says shipping is coordinated at checkout; no dedicated shipping page found.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

sources.supports: Products sold, cart at /carrito, homepage shipping mention and FAQ about coordinating shipping at checkout
